title: Import command with dry run, run-once guard and ID map
goal: NERV's export can be imported into FPVBuddy once, safely
acceptance: An import on the server host (a command, or an MCP write tool gated with approval if F-009-T01 leaves no host access; the record names which) validates the file, reports per-table counts in a dry run without writing, imports in one transaction, refuses a second run over the same export, and writes the NERV-to-FPVBuddy ID map to a path outside the repository
Specs on the invented fixture cover dry run, import, a refused second run and a malformed file
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Owner data, export files and ID maps never enter Git

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one transactional import over the core operations of F-005 and F-010. Not a measurement.
